note: A learning video is a SUNG educational song where each verse teaches exactly ONE item — a
letter, a number, or a shape. That taught item is carried on the verse itself as `story_subject`
(the exact renderable noun phrase, e.g. 'a big colorful letter A') and `learning_item` (a short
label, e.g. 'A'), which pipeline.kidsong.director honors as that verse's subject and — when
content_mode=learning — biases into an insert shot (the item shown large and clear, no people)
followed by a reaction shot (a child smiling and pointing at it). See director._fallback_planner.
As with prompts/pd_songs.json, every entry here is either a traceable public-domain text or
wholly ORIGINAL to this channel — never a riff on an existing show, brand, or recording. ACE-Step
generates a brand-new melody per episode regardless, so no existing tune/arrangement/recording is

3-5 verses of 2-4 short lines (<= 9 words each), a steady meter, at least one rhyming pair per

songs.title: ABC Time - A Letters Learning Sing-Along for Toddlers
songs.description: Zuri, Kofi and Nala point and clap as they learn their letters! Sing along and point at each big bright letter with us. #kidssong #learnthealphabet #abcsong #toddlersongs #singalong #preschool
songs.song_style: children's nursery rhyme, cheerful upbeat kids song, cute female child voice, simple very repetitive catchy melody, gentle bouncy tempo, playful, bright, warm

source.text: Original composition for Brainrot Studio's learning-song series
source.author: Brainrot Studio
source.public_domain: Not applicable — these are original lyrics written for this channel, not derived from or imitating any existing song, show or recording.
source.adaptation: The one-letter-per-verse teaching structure follows the long-standing public-domain convention of the traditional 'A-B-C' song (itself conventionally sung to the 1761 melody 'Ah! vous dirai-je, maman', the same tune underlying 'Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star' and 'Baa, Baa, Black Sheep'); ACE-Step generates an entirely new melody for this channel regardless, and no existing lyric text is reused anywhere in this file.
